text: 市场全天震荡分化，三大指数涨跌互现。食品等消费股走强，皇氏集团、香飘飘、一鸣食品等涨停。医药股延续涨势，百花医药5连板，亚太药业、哈药股份等多股涨停。黄金股震荡拉升，招金黄金、潮宏基、曼卡龙等涨停。军工板块表现活跃，洪都航空、湖南天雁、长城军工等涨停。下跌方面，PCB、CPO等算力硬件股下挫，泰金新能跌超8%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超4000股飘红，今日成交近2.54万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.67%，深成指涨0.04%，创业板指跌0.73%。
text_en: Markets oscillated divergently all day, with the three major indexes mixed. Consumer stocks like food gained, with Huangshi Group, Xiangpiaopiao, and Yiming Food hitting limit-up. Pharmaceutical stocks extended gains, with Baihua Pharmaceutical up five consecutive limit-ups, and Asia-Pacific Pharmaceutical, Hayao, and others hitting limit-up. Gold stocks rose and fluctuated, with Zhaojin Gold, Chaohongji, and Mankalong hitting limit-up. Defense sector was active, with Hongdu Aviation, Hunan Tianyan, and Great Wall Military hitting limit-up. On the downside, computing hardware stocks like PCB and CPO fell, with Taijin New Energy down over 8%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets in the green, and turnover near 2.54 trillion yuan. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.67%, the Shenzhen Component rose 0.04%, and the ChiNext fell 0.73%.
